a new method for the reliability S-N curve reconstruction of materials is proposed, and a series of fatigue reliability curves of railway vehicle Z230-450 cast steel are developed.

the reliability design, life prediction and reliability evaluation of the railway vehicle cast steel wheel in the entire life regime.
the reconstruction of fatigue reliability curves in an entire probability space and the development of the reliability S-N curves for the fatigue design and life prediction of vehicle structures.
the reconstruction of fatigue reliability S-N curve of ZG230- 450 railway vehicle cast steel in an entire probabilist sense.

the present curves can be used to realize the reliability design and fatigue life prediction at arbitrary reliability level in the mid-and short life regime and the reliability assessment in the long life regime for railway vehicle structures.

a probabilistic approach to the reconstruction of the fatigue S-N curves is a powerful tool for the reliability design, life prediction and reliability evaluation in the fatigue of engineering structures.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the reliability S-N curves in the entire probability sense have been established for the first time in China, which are expected to be used for the fatigue reliability design and fatigue life prediction of railway vehicle cast steel structures.

a new approach for reconstructing the reliability S-N curves in terms of the reliability level and fatigue life of materials is proposed and the reliability S-N curve of ZG230- 450 cast steel is established.
the fatigue reliability S -N curves are reconstructed by a Monte Carlo method, the maximum likelihood estimation method, and a probabilistic fatigue limit extraploation method.

the fatigue reliability curves in terms arbitrary reliability levels can be reconstructed by a Monte Carlo method and a maximum likelihood method.
